commands.detail: 3 tests: mapper projection, no refresh-token minting, inactive principal.
7 tests against the real HTTP server, PostgreSQL and Redis: exact pinned document, own-principal isolation, anonymous/revoked/suspended/non-owner rejection, no writes on rejection.

evidenceStatus.reason: The apps list includes admin and svadmin(sv), so the evidence checker also requires web (playwright/webJourney) evidence. That harness is W16 and is not built yet, so this record stays NOT_VERIFIED and is never counted as evidenced.

knownLimits: Unverified upstream behaviour, recorded rather than invented: userTypeId is the caller's own id (the same convention restaurantLogin already uses for a merchant principal), permissions is the caller's role list (as ownerLogin already returns), and restaurants is [] for ADMIN/STAFF. STAFF/VENDOR/RESTAURANT projections need the ownership records W5a adds.
No subscription event or browser shell is involved in this root.
